summary.text: Jessica Benham is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 36 who has served since December 1, 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Benham previously worked as director of development for the Pittsburgh Center for Autistic Advocacy.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Benham earned bachelor's degrees in political science and communication from Bethel University in 2012, an M.A. in communication from Minnesota State University, Mankato in 2015, and an M.A. in bioethics from the University of Pittsburgh in 2019.
Her career experience includes working as director of development for the Pittsburgh Center for Autistic Advocacy.
Benham assumed office on December 1, 2020, succeeding Harry Readshaw III.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Aging and Older Adult Services, Health, Human Services and Liquor Control committees.
